title: Paul's Ministry in Thessalonica

questions.question: Paul says, "For you yourselves know, brothers, that our coming to you was not in ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:1 (ESV): "For you yourselves know, brothers, that our coming to you was not in vain."

questions.question: But though we had already suffered and been shamefully treated at ____, as you know, we had boldness in our God to declare to you the gospel...
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:2 (ESV): "But though we had already suffered and been shamefully treated at Philippi, as you know, we had boldness in our God to declare to you the gospel of God in the midst of much conflict."

questions.question: For our appeal does not spring from error or impurity or any attempt to ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:3 (ESV): "For our appeal does not spring from error or impurity or any attempt to deceive,"

questions.question: But just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not to please ____, but to please God...
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:4 (ESV): "but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not to please man, but to please God who tests our hearts."

questions.question: who tests our ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:4 (ESV): "but to please God who tests our hearts."

questions.question: For we never came with words of ____, as you know, nor with a pretext for ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:5 (ESV): "For we never came with words of flattery, as you know, nor with a pretext for greed—God is witness."

questions.question: Nor did we seek glory from people, whether from you or from others, though we could have made ____ as apostles of Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:6 (ESV): "Nor did we seek glory from people, whether from you or from others, though we could have made demands as apostles of Christ."

questions.question: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing ____ taking care of her own children.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:7 (ESV): "But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother taking care of her own children."

questions.question: So, being affectionately desirous of you, we were ready to share with you not only the gospel of God but also our own ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:8 (ESV): "So, being affectionately desirous of you, we were ready to share with you not only the gospel of God but also our own selves, because you had become very dear to us." (Note: some versions say "our own lives", ESV says "our own selves").

questions.question: Paul reminds them of his labor and toil, how he worked ____, that he might not be a burden to any of them.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:9 (ESV): "For you remember, brothers, our labor and toil: we worked night and day, that we might not be a burden to any of you, while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God."

questions.question: For you know how, like a ____ with his children, we exhorted each one of you.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:11 (ESV): "For you know how, like a father with his children, we exhorted each one of you and encouraged you and charged you"

questions.question: We charged you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into his own ____ and glory.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:12 (ESV): "to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into his own kingdom and glory."

questions.question: When they received the word of God, they accepted it not as the word of men but as what it really is, the word of ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:13 (ESV): "when you received the word of God, which you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men but as what it really is, the word of God, which is at work in you believers."

questions.question: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Christ Jesus that are in ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:14 (ESV): "For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Christ Jesus that are in Judea. For you suffered the same things from your own countrymen as they did from the Jews,"

questions.question: Paul wanted to come to them again and again, but who hindered them?
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 2:18 (ESV): "because we wanted to come to you—I, Paul, again and again—but Satan hindered us."

key_verse_text: But just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not to please man, but to please God who tests our hearts.
